qualification_policy: Fresh exact-head evidence for all four profile/backend cells is published with the v1.0.0 GitHub Release; measured results remain release assets/body so source does not mutate after qualification.
source_provenance_note: Both GGUF Q8 and BF16 SafeTensors profiles execute through the pinned native stable-diffusion.cpp sd-cli runtime; SafeTensors support is not a Hugging Face Transformers inference backend. The generic core contains no /kaggle/* hard dependency; Kaggle is an adapter/reference environment.
